profile_candidate.scope: Node-only synthetic mTLS/SVID validation, credential refresh and safe transport audit; no deployment, Google identity or Python runtime installation.

access-boundary.claim: mTLS peer identity and expected SPIFFE trust domain are validated.

data-exposure.claim: Transport audit output avoids leaking credentials and private peer material.

untrusted-instructions.claim: Malformed or untrusted identity material fails validation without changing authority.

consequential-actions.claim: Credential fetch failures fail closed rather than silently trusting stale identity.

evidence-lineage.claim: Audit outcomes identify transport decisions using synthetic test identities.

bounded-claims.claim: Unit transport results remain distinct from full live SPIRE interoperability.
